title: Figure 8: Teflon (PTFE) structure, ball-and-stick molecular model and formula
description: A rendered ball-and-stick model of a PTFE chain with green fluorine atoms on a carbon backbone, shown beside the structural formula of the repeating -(CF2-CF2)n- unit. Caption: "Figure 8. Teflon Structure." It appears in the 'Teflon' section discussing PTFE and expanded PTFE (Goretex) for medical devices.
